question: Which attention5 heads implement the first source-to-final-query transport of the fixed two-term MLP4 write?
population: The same 64 valid A1/A2 discovery rows.

operator.capture: Capture native-base and two-term-writer-hybrid attention5 preprojection head outputs.
operator.intervention: At the final-subject query in a native base run, replace selected complete attention5 head outputs by writer-hybrid outputs before the fixed c_proj; native MLP5 and the exact suffix respond normally.
operator.arms: Writer; all nine heads; each of nine singleton heads; each of nine leave-one-out complements.
operator.attribution: Report singleton, full-minus-leave-one-out, and their equal-weight endpoint average for each head; this is not claimed as exact Shapley.

predictions.pred_a_exact_instrument: Native capture is exactly inert; selecting all nine heads matches direct complete attention5 preprojection replacement within 0.125 scored logit.
predictions.pred_b_writer_recurrence: The two-term writer recurs within 0.02 of mean recovery 0.33379277118533013 with positive A1/A2 recovery and direction fraction at least 0.80.
predictions.pred_c_attention5_recurrence: The all-head arm recurs within 0.01 of full block5 crossing recovery 0.055312640920517714, with A1/A2 recovery at least 0.04 and direction fraction at least 0.80.
predictions.pred_d_head_localization: At least one head has endpoint attribution at least 0.03, positive singleton recovery in A1/A2, and positive full-minus-leave-one-out drop in A1/A2.
predictions.pred_e_exact_coverage: All 20 arms produce all 64 finite outcomes within 48 model forward calls and 1536 example evaluations.

terminal.screen: A-E pass: license the reported head(s) as attention5 transport candidates and factor their source terms.
terminal.null: The run is valid but C or D fails: retain whole attention5 as the onset transporter.
terminal.invalid: Instrument identity, writer recurrence, native capability, finiteness, or coverage fails. No head, arm, row, or threshold may change after outcomes open.

novelty: First all-head sufficiency-plus-necessity decomposition of attention5 for a known upstream bilinear writer signal.
